overview_description.description: Zapier helps anyone to automate the most tedious parts of a day-to-day job. The company believes that there are jobs that a computer is best at doing and that there are jobs that a human is best at doing. Zapier wants to empower businesses everywhere to create processes and systems that let computers do what they are best at doing and let humans do what they are best at doing.

about_short_description.short_description: Zapier is an IT company that provides integrations for web applications for use in automated workflows.

product.name: Zapier Automation Platform
product.description: A cloud-based automation platform that connects 9,000+ apps to move data and execute actions across business workflows without requiring code.

product.name: Zapier AI
product.description: AI capabilities for creating and running automated workflows, including AI-assisted workflow building, content processing, classification, summarization, and connections to 400+ AI tools.

product.name: Zapier Agents
product.description: A platform for creating AI agents that perform defined tasks across connected business applications, such as qualifying leads, processing documents, routing tickets, and handling requests.

product.name: Zapier MCP
product.description: A Model Context Protocol service that lets AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor take authenticated actions across 9,000+ connected apps.

product.name: Zapier Tables
product.description: A structured data storage tool for creating tables that Zapier workflows can read, update, and use as part of automated business processes.

product.name: Zapier Forms
product.description: A no-code form and page builder that captures information and sends submissions into automated workflows connected to thousands of applications.
